findings.title: Leaked-password protection disabled
findings.justification: Toggle is in Supabase Dashboard → Authentication → Policies. Not code-fixable. Enable manually: Dashboard → Auth → Policies → Password Protection → ON.

findings.title: RLS policies evaluate to USING (true)
findings.justification: App uses a custom app_users/app_sessions auth that connects to Supabase as the anon role. Tightening these policies to auth.uid() would lock every screen out until the full Supabase Auth migration (see AUTH_MIGRATION_PLAN.md) is complete.

findings.title: Postgres minor version has known CVEs
findings.justification: Postgres upgrade is performed in Supabase Dashboard → Project Settings → Infrastructure → Upgrade. Schedule a maintenance window and click Upgrade.

findings.title: advance_entries readable/writable by anon
findings.justification: Custom-auth app uses the anon role for every browser request. Closing anon access requires migrating to Supabase Auth so RLS can key off auth.uid().

findings.title: advances readable/writable by anon
findings.justification: Same anon-role limitation as advance_entries. Will close after Supabase Auth migration.

findings.title: app_settings writable by anon
findings.justification: Settings panel writes from the browser as anon. Will be moved behind Supabase Auth + admin role check.

findings.title: app_users.password_hash readable by anon
findings.justification: Login currently runs via the auth-login edge function with bcrypt verification server-side; the table still grants SELECT to anon for the legacy app_users_public view. Whole table is retired by AUTH_MIGRATION_PLAN.md step 9.

findings.title: attendance readable/writable by anon
findings.justification: Anon-role limitation. Closes after Supabase Auth migration with manager-by-location and admin-all RLS.

findings.title: break_events readable/writable by anon
findings.justification: Same anon-role limitation as attendance.

findings.title: face_embeddings readable by anon
findings.justification: Biometric template exposure. Will move behind Supabase Auth + manager-by-location policy; embeddings are 128-d floats (non-reversible) but still treated as PII.

findings.title: face_registration_logs readable by anon
findings.justification: Audit table; same anon limitation.

findings.title: face-samples storage bucket world-readable
findings.justification: Storage bucket is already marked private. Wiz flags it because the storage policy still allows anon SELECT to support the kiosk flow. Will be replaced with a signed-URL flow brokered by an edge function after Supabase Auth lands.

findings.title: leave_requests readable/writable by anon
findings.justification: Anon-role limitation.

findings.title: locations.device_config readable by anon
findings.justification: Device config (vendor, IP, port) is loaded by the kiosk page on boot via the anon role. After migration, kiosk will use a signed device token instead.

findings.title: old_staff_records readable/writable by anon
findings.justification: Anon-role limitation.

findings.title: part_time_advance_tracking readable/writable by anon
findings.justification: Anon-role limitation.

findings.title: payroll_runs readable/writable by anon
findings.justification: Anon-role limitation.

findings.title: payroll_snapshots readable/writable by anon
findings.justification: Anon-role limitation.

findings.title: punch_events readable/writable by anon
findings.justification: Anon-role limitation. Device-push edge function already uses a service token for cloud devices; browser kiosk still uses anon.

findings.title: salary_hikes readable/writable by anon
findings.justification: Anon-role limitation.

findings.title: salary_manual_overrides readable/writable by anon
findings.justification: Anon-role limitation.

findings.title: staff readable/writable by anon
findings.justification: Largest PII surface (Aadhaar, PAN, PF, ESI, salary). Anon-role limitation; will be locked to admin-all and manager-by-location after Supabase Auth migration.
